name: Narrows
author: Mark Steere (2026) / AGP port
description: Mark Steere's 2026 connection game on a Kōnane board — a rectangular grid filled with a checkerboard of black and white stones. Every move is a rook capture by replacement: slide one of your stones orthogonally onto the first enemy stone it can see and take its place. You win the moment all of your stones are linked to one another through open water — orthogonal paths of empty points and friendly stones — and you can win on your opponent's turn as well as your own. The pie rule applies.
